title: ENDOMOTOR X Endodontic Motor
subtitle: Wireless endodontic motor
summary: A compact endodontic motor for root canal preparation, designed for controlled rotary filing, comfortable handheld operation and daily chairside endodontic workflows.
sellingHeading: Why clinics choose the ENDOMOTOR X

sellingPoints.title: Cordless endodontic workflow
sellingPoints.description: The handheld motor supports flexible movement around the treatment chair during root canal preparation.

sellingPoints.title: Mini rotary head access
sellingPoints.description: The compact head design helps improve access and visibility during canal treatment.

sellingPoints.title: Stable root canal preparation
sellingPoints.description: Designed for controlled rotary-file operation in routine endodontic procedures.

sellingPoints.title: Convenient daily charging
sellingPoints.description: The charging base keeps the motor organized and ready for regular clinic use.

featureHeading: Built around root canal preparation workflows

features.title: Flexible chairside handling
features.description: The slim handheld body supports easy movement during endodontic treatment without a trailing power cable.

features.title: Better access to posterior canals
features.description: The compact head profile helps dentists reach treatment areas while maintaining visibility around the tooth.

features.title: Organized daily storage and charging
features.description: The dedicated charging base keeps the motor upright, protected and ready between procedures.

features.title: Controlled rotary-file use
features.description: The motor is prepared for routine canal shaping workflows where steady file movement and comfortable handling are required.
